definitions.explanation: The act of formally creating or founding an organization, institution, or company. Implies official, structured creation with legal or institutional standing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設立|せつりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1900⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{設立|せつりつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{基金|ききん}→基金：20400_kikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設立|せつりつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Preparations are underway for the establishment of a new fund.

notes:
USAGE:
{設立|せつりつ} is used for the formal founding of organizations, companies, schools, and institutions. It implies a deliberate, structured creation process with official status. Compare with ⟦{創設|そうせつ}→創設：11905_sousetsu⟧ (creation/founding, emphasizing the pioneering aspect), ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧ (founding of a business), and ⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧ (coming into being, establishment of laws or agreements).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{設立|せつりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to establish a company
- {設立|せつりつ}{者|しゃ}: founder
- {設立|せつりつ}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: year of establishment
- {設立|せつりつ}{趣意書|しゅいしょ}: founding prospectus
